set_printoptions_precision: set tensor print precision to 2 decimal places for cleaner output
set_printoptions_threshold: set print threshold to 5 to summarize large tensors with ellipsis
get_printoptions: get current tensor print options as a dictionary for inspection or restoration
printoptions_context: use printoptions context manager to temporarily change precision for a code block
summarize_tensor_repr: summarize the tensor string representation with custom indentation and formatting
